notes: An owner publishes two ordinary class attributes and registers an object. Unpublishing only one class attribute immediately makes its corresponding instance attribute unowned while the other remains owned. A separate observer's public Query Attribute Ownership reports the unowned and retained-owner results. The native official-API focused CTest passed 1/1. Installed-package portable C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 direct runs and 4/4 focused CTests across both callback models (out/mgw/ownership-unpublish-owned-candidate-20261021.json). Java provider runtime, other publication-state transitions, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
